name: Andritz AG
summary: Andritz AG engages in the provision of industrial machinery, equipment, and services in Europe, North America, South America, China, Asia, Africa, Australia, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Pulp & Paper, Metals, Hydropower, and Environment & Energy. The Pulp & Paper segment provides technology, automation, and service solutions to produce pulp, paper, board, and tissue; boilers for power generation; nonwovens technologies; panelboard production systems; and recycling, shredding, and energy solutions for various waste materials.
